text: Let f be a non-negative function in [0, 1] and twice differentiable in (0, 1). If $\int\limits _{0}^{x}\sqrt{1-(f^{'}(t))^{2}}dt=\int\limits _{0}^{x}f(t)dt$, $0\leq x\leq 1$ and f(0) = 0, then $\lim _{x\to 0}\frac{1}{x^{2}}\int\limits _{0}^{x}f(t)dt$ :
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2021 (Online) 31st August Morning Shift via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

solution.body:
$\int\limits _{0}^{x}\sqrt{1-(f^{'}(t))^{2}}dt=\int\limits _{0}^{x}f(t)dt,0\leq x\leq 1$

differentiating both the sides

$\sqrt{1-(f^{'}(x))^{2}}=f(x)$

$\Rightarrow 1-(f^{'}(x))^{2}=f^{2}(x)$

$\frac{f^{'}(x)}{\sqrt{1-f^{2}(x)}}=1$

$\sin ^{-1}f(x)=x+C$

$\because$ $f(0)=0\Rightarrow C=0\Rightarrow f(x)=\sin x$

Now, $\lim _{x\to 0}\frac{\int\limits _{0}^{x}\sin tdt}{x^{2}}\left (\frac{0}{0}\right )=\frac{1}{2}$
sourceReferences: ExamSIDE explanation for JEE Main 2021 (Online) 31st August Morning Shift

text:
Let $\vec{a}$ and $\vec{b}$ be two vectors 
such that $\left |2\vec{a}+3\vec{b}\right |=\left |3\vec{a}+\vec{b}\right |$ and the angle between $\vec{a}$ and $\vec{b}$ is 60${}^{\circ }$. If $\frac{1}{8}\vec{a}$ is a unit vector, then $\left |\vec{b}\right |$ is equal to :
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2021 (Online) 31st August Morning Shift via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

solution.body:
$\left |3\vec{a}+\vec{b}\right |^{2}=\left |2\vec{a}+3\vec{b}\right |^{2}$

$\left (3\vec{a}+\vec{b}\right ).\left (3\vec{a}+\vec{b}\right )=\left (2\vec{a}+3\vec{b}\right ).\left (2\vec{a}+3\vec{b}\right )$

$9\vec{a}.\vec{a}+6\vec{a}.\vec{b}+\vec{b}.\vec{b}=4\vec{a}.\vec{a}+12\vec{a}.\vec{b}+9\vec{b}.\vec{b}$

$5\left |\vec{a}\right |^{2}-6\vec{a}.\vec{b}=8\left |\vec{b}\right |^{2}$

$5(8)^{2}-6.8.\left |\vec{b}\right |\cos 60^{\circ }=8\left |\vec{b}\right |^{2}$ $\because$ $⎛⎝⎜\begin{array}{l} \frac{1}{8}\left |\vec{a}\right |=1 \\ \Rightarrow \left |\vec{a}\right |=8 \end{array}⎞⎠⎟$

$40-3\left |\vec{b}\right |=\left |\vec{b}\right |^{2}$

$\Rightarrow \left |\vec{b}\right |^{2}+3\left |\vec{b}\right |-40=0$

$\left |\vec{b}\right |=-8$, $\left |\vec{b}\right |=5$

(rejected)
sourceReferences: ExamSIDE explanation for JEE Main 2021 (Online) 31st August Morning Shift

text: Three numbers are in an increasing geometric progression with common ratio r. If the middle number is doubled, then the new numbers are in an arithmetic progression with common difference d. If the fourth term of GP is $3 r^{2}$, then $r^{2}$ $-$ d is equal to :
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2021 (Online) 31st August Morning Shift via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

solution.body:
Let numbers be $\frac{a}{r}$, a, ar $\to$ G.P.

$\frac{a}{r}$, 2a, ar $\to$ A.P. $\Rightarrow$ 4a = $\frac{a}{r}$ + ar $\Rightarrow$ r + $\frac{1}{r}$ = 4

r = 2 $\pm$ $\sqrt{3}$

$4^{th}$ term of $G.P. = 3r^{2}$ $\Rightarrow$ $ar^{2} = 3r^{2}$ $\Rightarrow$ a = 3

r = 2 + $\sqrt{3}$, a = 3, d = 2a $-$ $\frac{a}{r}$ = 3$\sqrt{3}$

$r^{2}$ $-$ d = (2 + $\sqrt{3})^{2}$ $-$ 3$\sqrt{3}$

= 7 + 4$\sqrt{3}$ $-$ 3$\sqrt{3}$

= 7 + $\sqrt{3}$
sourceReferences: ExamSIDE explanation for JEE Main 2021 (Online) 31st August Morning Shift

text:
If p and q are the lengths of the perpendiculars from the origin on the lines,

x cosec $α$ $-$ y sec $α$ = k cot 2$α$ and

x sin$α$ + y cos$α$ = k sin2$α$

respectively, then $k^{2}$ is equal to :
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2021 (Online) 31st August Morning Shift via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)
tags: straight lines and pair of straight lines

solution.body:
First line is $\frac{x}{\sin α}-\frac{y}{\cos α}=\frac{k\cos 2α}{\sin 2α}$

$\Rightarrow x\cos α-y\sin α=\frac{k}{2}\cos 2α$ 

$\Rightarrow p=\left |\frac{k}{2}\cos 2α\right |\Rightarrow 2p=|k\cos 2α|$ .... (i)

second line is $x\sin α+y\cos α=k\sin 2α$

$\Rightarrow q=|k\sin 2α|$ .... (ii)

Hence, $4p^{2}+q^{2}=k^{2}$ (From (i) & (ii))
sourceReferences: ExamSIDE explanation for JEE Main 2021 (Online) 31st August Morning Shift

text:
If the function 
$f(x)=\left \{\begin{array}{lll} \frac{1}{x}\log _{e}\left (\frac{1+\frac{x}{a}}{1-\frac{x}{b}}\right ) & , & x<0 \\ k & , & x=0 \\ \frac{\cos ^{2}x-\sin ^{2}x-1}{\sqrt{x^{2}+1}-1} & , & x>0 \end{array} \right.$ is continuous 

at x = 0, then $\frac{1}{a}+\frac{1}{b}+\frac{4}{k}$ is equal to :
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2021 (Online) 31st August Morning Shift via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

solution.body:
If f(x) is continuous at x = 0, RHL = LHL = f(0)

$\lim _{x\to 0^{+}}f(x)=\lim _{x\to 0^{+}}\frac{\cos ^{2}x-\sin ^{2}x-1}{\sqrt{x^{2}+1}-1}.\frac{\sqrt{x^{2}+1}+1}{\sqrt{x^{2}+1}+1}$ (Rationalisation)

$\lim _{x\to 0^{+}}-\frac{2\sin ^{2}x}{x^{2}}.\left (\sqrt{x^{2}+1}+1\right )=-4$

$\lim _{x\to 0^{-}}f(x)=\lim _{x\to 0^{-}}\frac{1}{x}\ln \left (\frac{1+\frac{x}{a}}{1-\frac{x}{b}}\right )$

$\lim _{x\to 0^{-}}\frac{\ln \left (1+\frac{x}{a}\right )}{\left (\frac{x}{a}\right ).a}+\frac{\ln \left (1-\frac{x}{b}\right )}{\left (-\frac{x}{b}\right ).b}=\frac{1}{a}+\frac{1}{b}$

So, $\frac{1}{a}+\frac{1}{b}=-4=k$

$\Rightarrow \frac{1}{a}+\frac{1}{b}+\frac{4}{k}=-4-1=-5$
sourceReferences: ExamSIDE explanation for JEE Main 2021 (Online) 31st August Morning Shift

text: $\lim _{x\to 0}\frac{\sin ^{2}\left (π\cos ^{4}x\right )}{x^{4}}$ is equal to :
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2021 (Online) 31st August Morning Shift via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

solution.body:
Since $\sin (π-θ)=\sin θ$,

$\sin \left (π\cos ^{4}x\right )=\sin \left (π\left (1-\cos ^{4}x\right )\right )$

and $1-\cos ^{4}x=(1-\cos ^{2}x)(1+\cos ^{2}x)=\sin ^{2}x(1+\cos ^{2}x)$.

Let $u=π\sin ^{2}x(1+\cos ^{2}x)$. As $x\to 0$, $u\to 0$ and $\dfrac{u}{x^{2}}\to π\cdot 1\cdot 2=2π$.

$\lim _{x\to 0}\frac{\sin ^{2}(π\cos ^{4}x)}{x^{4}}=\lim _{x\to 0}\left (\frac{\sin u}{u}\right )^{2}\left (\frac{u}{x^{2}}\right )^{2}=1\cdot (2π)^{2}=4π^{2}$

Hence, the correct option is (C).
sourceReferences: ExamSIDE explanation for JEE Main 2021 (Online) 31st August Morning Shift

text:
Let [t] denote the greatest integer $\leq$ t. Then the value of 

$8.\int\limits _{-\frac{1}{2}}^{1}([2x]+|x|)dx$ is $___________$.
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2021 (Online) 31st August Morning Shift via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

solution.body:
$I=\int\limits _{-\frac{1}{2}}^{1}([2x]+|x|)dx$

$=\int\limits _{-1/2}^{1}[2x]dx+\int\limits _{-1/2}^{1}|x|dx$

$=0+\int\limits _{-1/2}^{0}(-x)dx+\int\limits _{0}^{1}xdx$

$=\left (-\frac{x^{2}}{2}\right )_{-1/2}^{0}+\left (\frac{x^{2}}{2}\right )_{0}^{1}$

$=\left (0+\frac{1}{8}\right )+\frac{1}{2}$

$=\frac{5}{8}$

$\therefore$ 8I = 5
sourceReferences: ExamSIDE explanation for JEE Main 2021 (Online) 31st August Morning Shift

text: A point z moves in the complex plane such that $\arg \left (\frac{z-2}{z+2}\right )=\frac{π}{4}$, then the minimum value of $\left |z-9\sqrt{2}-2i\right |^{2}$ is equal to $_______________$.
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2021 (Online) 31st August Morning Shift via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

solution.body:
Let $z=x+iy$

$\arg \left (\frac{x-2+iy}{x+2+iy}\right )=\frac{π}{4}$

$\arg (x-2+iy)-\arg (x+2+iy)=\frac{π}{4}$

$\tan ^{-1}\left (\frac{y}{x-2}\right )-\tan ^{-1}\left (\frac{y}{x+2}\right )=\frac{π}{4}$

$\frac{\frac{y}{x-2}-\frac{y}{x+2}}{1+\left (\frac{y}{x-2}\right ).\left (\frac{y}{x+2}\right )}=\tan \frac{π}{4}=1$

$\frac{xy+2y-xy+2y}{x^{2}-4+y^{2}}=1$

$4y=x^{2}-4+y^{2}$

$x^{2}+y^{2}-4y-4=0$

locus is a circle with center (0, 2) & radius = $2\sqrt{2}$


[IMG]


min. value = $(AP)^{2}=(OP-OA)^{2}$

$=\left (9\sqrt{2}-2\sqrt{2}\right )^{2}$

$=\left (7\sqrt{2}\right )^{2}=98$
sourceReferences: ExamSIDE explanation for JEE Main 2021 (Online) 31st August Morning Shift

text:
If 'R' is the least value of 'a' such that the function $f(x) = x^{2} + ax + 1$ is increasing on [1, 2] and 'S' is the greatest value of 'a' such that the function $f(x) = x^{2} + ax + 1$ is decreasing on [1, 2], then 
the value of |R $-$ S| is $___________$.
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2021 (Online) 31st August Morning Shift via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

solution.body:
$f(x) = x^{2} + ax + 1$

f'(x) = 2x + a

when f(x) is increasing on [1, 2]

2x + a $\geq$ 0 $\forall$ x$\in$[1, 2]

a $\geq$ $-$2x $\forall$ x$\in$[1, 2]

R = $-$4

when f(x) is decreasing on [1, 2]

2x + a $\leq$ 0 $\forall$ x$\in$[1, 2]

a $\leq$ $-$2 $\forall$ x$\in$[1, 2]

S = $-$2

|R $-$ S| = | $-$4 + 2 | = 2
sourceReferences: ExamSIDE explanation for JEE Main 2021 (Online) 31st August Morning Shift

text:
If the variable line 3x + 4y = $α$ lies between the two 
circles (x $-$ $1)^{2} + (y$ $-$ $1)^{2} = 1$ 
and (x $-$ $9)^{2} + (y$ $-$ $1)^{2} = 4$, without intercepting a chord on either circle, then the sum of all the integral values of $α$ is $___________$.
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2021 (Online) 31st August Morning Shift via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

solution.body:
[IMG]


Both centers should lie on either side of the line as well as line can be tangent to circle.

(3 + 4 $-$ $α$) . (27 + 4 $-$ $α$) < 0

(7 $-$ $α$) . (31 $-$ $α$) < 0 $\Rightarrow$ $α$ $\in$ (7, 31) ....... (1)

$d_{1} =$ distance of (1, 1) from line

$d_{2} =$ distance of (9, 1) from line

$d_{1}\geq r_{1}\Rightarrow \frac{|7-α|}{5}\geq 1\Rightarrow α\in (-\infty ,2]\cup [12,\infty )$ .... (2)

$d_{2}\geq r_{2}\Rightarrow \frac{|31-α|}{5}\geq 2\Rightarrow α\in (-\infty ,21]\cup [41,\infty )$ ....(3)

(1) $\cap$ (2) $\cap$ (3) $\Rightarrow$ $α$ $\in$ [12, 21]

Sum of integers = 165

text: An electric instrument consists of two units. Each unit must function independently for the instrument to operate. The probability that the first unit functions is 0.9 and that of the second unit is 0.8. The instrument is switched on and it fails to operate. If the probability that only the first unit failed and second unit is functioning is p, then 98 p is equal to $_____________$.
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2021 (Online) 31st August Morning Shift via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

solution.body:
$I_{1} =$ first unit is functioning

$I_{2} =$ second unit is functioning

$P(I_{1}) = 0.9, P(I_{2}) = 0.8$

P($I_{1}–$) = 0.1, P($I_{2}–$) = 0.2

$P=\frac{0.8\times 0.1}{0.1\times 0.2+0.9\times 0.2+0.1\times 0.8}=\frac{8}{28}$

$98P=\frac{8}{28}\times 98=28$
sourceReferences: ExamSIDE explanation for JEE Main 2021 (Online) 31st August Morning Shift
